introduction: Established in Lahore in 1882, the University of Punjab is the largest and the oldest seat of higher learning in Pakistan. It was the first to be established in the sub-continent in a Muslim majority area. Located in the historical and culturally alive city of Lahore, this university has played a leading role in spreading higher education in the country. The University comprises six campuses, 19 Faculties, 08 Constituent Colleges, and 138 departments, centers, and institutes.

software_engineering.program_description: The BS Software Engineering program aims to produce graduates with a strong foundation in computing, capable of applying theoretical concepts to solve problems, using appropriate methodologies and tools for software design and testing. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in the IT industry, graduate studies, and lifelong learning, with strong communication skills.

Intermediate with Mathematics & Statistics with atleast 50% obtained marks

electrical_engineering.program_description: Exhibit comprehensive competence in the field of electrical engineering, enabling graduates to achieve successful careers in both industry and higher education sectors. Pursue research and innovation, providing effective industrial solutions through the adoption and integration of emerging technologies. Capacity to lead or participate as an effective team member to provide environment-friendly, sustainable, and economical solutions with good communication skills and high moral values.
